discussion_comments.comment_body: @Abhijay007 can you address this Codex code review comment if it's legitimate?

The loader now applies the saved delta even when it's 0.

The root issue was that `MIN_NAV_WIDTH === CONDENSED_WIDTH === 200`, so dragging to minimum produces `delta = 0`, which the old if (`delta !== 0`) guard incorrectly skipped.

Changed `navExpandedWidth` to `number | null` with null as default (instead of 0) so we can distinguish:

- null → never resized, use the component default ('30%')
- 0 → explicitly dragged to minimum, restore to MIN_NAV_WIDTH
-  `> 0` → dragged wider, restore exact width

Re: as per @DOsinga's suggestion to use number with default 0, the delta storage concept is kept, but null is necessary as the "never set" sentinel. If we used 0 for both "never set" and "set to minimum", a fresh install would start the expanded nav at 200px instead of '30%', which hurts the out-of-the-box experience for fresh install user

Fixed in 82bea0730. Changed the guard to `editedMessage !== undefined` instead of a truthiness check, so empty-text image-only forks still pass `initialMessage` through and submit the kept images. Both SESSION_FORKED dispatchers always set `editedMessage`, so no regression for the previous undefined case.

Fixed in 93295522e. `archivedFilterFor` now decides on `keyword.trim()`, matching `acpListSessions` (which trims and omits an empty query) — a whitespace-only search no longer widens the Active view to archived sessions.

Fixed in 82bea0730. Moved `keepImages` computation above the empty-text check; now rejecting only when both `editContent` is empty and `keepImages` is empty. Image-only edits and removing some of several attached images no longer trigger the empty-message error.
